blocks.text:
Lunches and dinners.

Before purchasing a domestic flight ticket, you must confirm the flight number with the reservations department. The recommended departure time from Mexico City is between 12:00 and 13:00.

Passengers arriving on other flights can only be provided with private transfers at an additional charge: 1–3 people, $230; 4–5 people, $280.

For domestic flights, select Aeropuerto Internacional Benito Juarez Ciudad de Mexico, AICM, airport code MEX.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word has a general meals clause but no RU domestic-flight confirmation, 12:00–13:00 departure window, MEX airport instruction or private-transfer charges of $230/$280.
